knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Deep patches are filled in lifts and dried, and paint is applied only when the surface is dry.
A straight edge and raking light show high and low spots and trowel marks.
The lesson says deep patches are filled in lifts, each thinner than the last, and that each lift is allowed to stiffen before the next.

practicalCriteria: Given a simulated deep patch, the worker fills in lifts, applies a skim, and checks the finish with a straight edge and raking light.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Patch and skim record with drying times
stopWorkCriteria: The base is not dry or bonded
